Part of the confirmation email upon registering for a LiXiangQi account.
The unique reset link is presented just after this string.

resources.string: Sit ɣef useɣwen i urmad n umiḍan-inek LiXiangQi account:
Wennez awal uffir-inek lixiangqi.com,%s
Yettwazen-aɣ-d usuter n uwennez n wawal uffir n umiḍan-inek.
Ma yella d kečč id yessutren, sit ɣef useɣwen-a n wadda.Ma ulac, tzemreḍ ad stanfeḍ.
Sentem tansa n yimayl tamaynut,%s
Tessutreḍ abeddel n tansa n yimayl-inek.
Amiḍan-ik LiXiangQi ihegga. Ma telliḍ tettlemdeḍ ilugan neɣ tuɣaleḍ ɣer wurar, nefṛeḥ imi telliḍ dagi.
Urar xiangqi
Bdu urar seg usebter agejdan. I wurar amezwaru s lehna, ɛreḍ ad turareḍ mgal aselkim.
Ɛreḍ tamseɛreqt
Lmed ad twaliḍ amihi d tikliwin n tarna. Ur srusuy ara: wali tikliwin ara k-id-yerren amurar-nniḍen.
Ssin iman-ik
Rnu awal awezlan ɣef iman-ik deg ulegdis-ik akken imuraren-nniḍen ad k-issinen.
Wali alegdis-ik
Zreg alegdis-ik
Urar s lferḥ. Ad nemlil deg wurar!
Ansuf ɣer lixiangqi.com, %s
Wagi d imayl n umeẓlu yerzan aseqdec-ik n %s.
I wakken ad aɣ-d-tessiwḍeḍ, seqdec %s.
